title: pinus armandi var. fenzeliana
intro: Pinus armandi var. fenzeliana, commonly known as Chinese nut pine, is a variant of the Chinese white pine, a species of evergreen coniferous tree native to China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and bronchitis, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus armandi var. fenzeliana include reducing inflammation and fighting off infections, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including pinosylvin, pinosylvin methyl ether, and other phenolic compounds. These constituents are responsible for its antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable plant for therapeutic purposes.
